description: This file is a PHP script for rendering the Edit View of Quotes in a CRM system, likely Vtiger or SugarCRM, handling data retrieval, form setup, and display logic for creating or editing quote records.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Base class for CRM entities, providing instance retrieval.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine wrapper for CRM views.

methods.name: getAssociatedProducts
methods.description: Retrieves products associated with a given module and record.

methods.name: getPricesForProducts
methods.description: Fetches prices for specified products in a given currency.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Returns the name of a product given its ID.

methods.name: getPrdQtyInStck
methods.description: Returns the quantity in stock for a product.

methods.name: getProductTaxPercentage
methods.description: Retrieves tax percentage for a product based on tax type.

methods.name: getAllTaxes
methods.description: Gets all available taxes, optionally filtered by type and mode.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Returns the parent tab/category of the module.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Determines the view mode (edit/create) for the form.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves UI blocks for the module's form.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Provides update information for a record.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Returns the tab ID for a given module.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data into field names, types, and labels.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence number field for the module.

methods.name: getTranslatedString
methods.description: Returns translated string for a given key.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks and returns button permissions for the module.
